properties.name: demo-collect-to-open
properties.description: Example: collect N pickups, then the exit opens. The logic is the external events "CollectToOpen" (objects Player, Pickup, PickupSpot, Exit; variables PickupsCollected, PickupsToCollect), the HUD is the external layout "CollectToOpenHud" (KeysBar, KeysText on the layer "UI").

events.comment: Collect to open: PickupsToCollect pickups appear on random PickupSpot markers. The player collects them by walking on them. When all are collected, the Exit is deleted. Distances are in pixels (50 pixels = 1 meter).
The markers left are not needed anymore.

parameters: "All keys found: the exit is open"

tests.description: Moves the player onto each pickup: the exit is removed after the last one, and not before.
tests.name: Collecting every pickup opens the exit
source: // Collecting every pickup opens the exit, and not before. Written without any position of the level:
// the player is moved onto each pickup.
await harness.goToScene('Game');
await harness.stepFrames(3);
const pickupsToCollect = harness.getSceneVariable('PickupsToCollect').value;
harness.assert(harness.getObjects('Pickup').length === pickupsToCollect, 'There are ' + pickupsToCollect + ' pickups at the start (found ' + harness.getObjects('Pickup').length + ').');
harness.assert(harness.getObjects('PickupSpot').length === 0, 'The pickup spot markers are removed at the start.');
harness.assert(harness.getObjects('Exit').length === 1, 'The exit is closed at the start.');
harness.assert(harness.getObjects('KeysText')[0].text === 'Keys 0/' + pickupsToCollect, 'The HUD shows "Keys 0/' + pickupsToCollect + '" (shows "' + harness.getObjects('KeysText')[0].text + '").');
await harness.takeScreenshot('start', { width: 768 });
for (let collected = 1; collected <= pickupsToCollect; collected++) {
const pickup = harness.getObjects('Pickup')[0];
const player = harness.getObjects('Player')[0];
harness.setObjectPosition(player.id, player.x + pickup.centerX - player.centerX, player.y + pickup.centerY - player.centerY, player.z);
await harness.stepFrames(3);
harness.assert(harness.getSceneVariable('PickupsCollected').value === collected, 'Walking on a pickup collects it (' + collected + ' collected).');
harness.assert(harness.getObjects('Pickup').length === pickupsToCollect - collected, 'The collected pickup is removed.');
if (collected < pickupsToCollect) {
harness.assert(harness.getObjects('Exit').length === 1, 'The exit stays closed with ' + collected + ' of ' + pickupsToCollect + ' pickups.');
harness.assert(harness.getObjects('KeysText')[0].text === 'Keys ' + collected + '/' + pickupsToCollect, 'The HUD shows "Keys ' + collected + '/' + pickupsToCollect + '".');
await harness.stepFrames(2);
harness.assert(harness.getObjects('Exit').length === 0, 'The exit is removed once every pickup is collected.');
const bar = harness.getObjects('KeysBar')[0].state;
harness.assert(bar.Value === pickupsToCollect && bar.MaxValue === pickupsToCollect, 'The HUD bar is full (' + bar.Value + '/' + bar.MaxValue + ').');
console.log('HUD text at the end: ' + harness.getObjects('KeysText')[0].text + ', bar value: ' + JSON.stringify(harness.getObjects('KeysBar')[0].state));
await harness.takeScreenshot('end', { width: 768 });

description: A bar that represents a resource in the game (health, mana, ammo, etc).
There are ready-to-use resource bars in the asset-store [resource bars pack](https://editor.gdevelop.io/?initial-dialog=asset-store&asset-pack=resource-bars-resource-bars).

changelog.breaking: - Resource bars now use "variants", allowing easy swapping of their visual aspect. You will have to make some adjustments to existing resource bars in your project. Follow this [migration documentation](https://wiki.gdevelop.io/gdevelop5/objects/custom-objects-prefab-template/migrate-to-variants/) to do these changes.
